summary: The data shows that service requests make up the majority of support activities, representing 52.79% of the total, while incidents account for 47.21%. This slight difference suggests that the IT or support team is dealing more frequently with routine or planned tasks rather than unexpected disruptions. The close distribution also indicates that both proactive services and reactive issue handling are significant components of the team's workload, pointing to a balanced demand between maintaining ongoing operations and resolving unplanned problems.
